Hina — offline (traditional website)

How to use
1. Open index.html in any browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox).
2. No install. No internet required for chat, photos, or saved videos.
3. EN / اردو / سنڌي buttons change language.
4. Voice uses the female voice on your device. For Urdu and Sindhi, a Hindi/Urdu female voice is used when available.

Founder: Hameed IT Assistant made Hina. Hameed is her founder.
